narrative_synthesis: The meta right now is distress-as-opportunity and dead-simple numbered lists. Drafts for today: (1) a Philly 'a rental pays you 4 ways' list, (2) a 'high rates killed easy deals, not deals' creative-finance take, (3) a this-or-that seller-finance reply magnet.

drafts.draft_en:
A Philly rowhome pays you 4 ways:

1/ Rent that covers the note
2/ A tenant paying your loan down every month
3/ Appreciation while you sleep
4/ Tax benefits (ask your CPA)

Most people only count #1. That's why they never buy #2.
drafts.pattern: numbered 'a rental pays you 4 ways' list (theficouple format) + Philly local angle + curiosity close
drafts.video_tip: Walk past a rowhouse block, 20-30s, count on your fingers. Say line one in the first 2 seconds. Keep point 4 general and say 'talk to your CPA' on screen.

drafts.draft_en:
High rates didn't kill real estate deals.

They killed easy deals.

Sellers with low-rate mortgages and no buyers are open to terms right now: seller financing, subject-to, lease options.

The investors asking better questions are building legacy while everyone else waits.
drafts.pattern: distress-as-opportunity framing (GrantCardone 15k star) without the hype, + creative finance keywords + legacy theme
drafts.video_tip: Talking head, 30-40s, start mid-sentence on 'High rates didn't kill deals.' Cut to a whiteboard with the three terms written out. No numbers or promises of returns.

drafts.draft_en:
Which deal are you taking?

A) Pay full cash price, close fast, no seller involvement
B) Pay 10% more, seller finances it at a low rate for 10 years

Same Philly property. Explain your pick.
drafts.pattern: this-or-that seller-finance question (andexcapital format) + 'explain your pick' reply driver
drafts.video_tip: Skip video, or use a split-screen graphic with A and B. Reply to the first 10 answers within the hour and share your own pick after an hour.
